notes: Creativity traps excluded: 'Creator and Other' and App Engine are low-code enterprise app development, not artistic creation. 'Design' in professional services means implementation and architecture. 'Tell meaningful talent stories' is HR data language. Marketing brand campaigns are not scored. Cross-cultural: Now Assist for FSM mentions 'multilingual knowledge creation', and a customer case cites a portal in 'more than 10 languages'. These are incidental product features or a customer's own deployment rather than an access program, so I left them unscored at the lower level. 'Accessible to users with varying technical expertise' and WSD 'accessible work environments' are not inclusion activities. RiseUp's focus on people 'without traditional technology backgrounds' does not explicitly target underrepresented cultural or demographic groups, so it is counted for Community only. Community exclusions: customer support online training, the Knowledge user conference and the World Forums are customer education and marketing. The EVS and total rewards are employee programs, but they add nothing above E1 and E2. ServiceNow University launched in 2025 and is current. Coverage: the human capital section is over 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural are marked sufficient and no second look is triggered. The targeted Item 7 excerpt repeats the business overview and adds no qualifying activity.
